SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  cls,
  COUNT(*) as num_trips,
  ROUND(SUM(yt), 1) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 145 AND fish_date_doy <= 152
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC;

SELECT 
  fish_date_doy,
  COUNT(*) as total_trips,
  SUM(yt) as total_yt,
  ROUND(AVG(yt), 2) as avg_yt_per_trip,
  ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler,
  MIN(cls) as sample_class
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy >= 287 AND fish_date_doy <= 305 AND fish_date_season = 1
GROUP BY fish_date_doy
ORDER BY yt_per_angler DESC
LIMIT 20;

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as trips, ROUND(SUM(yt) / NULLIF(SUM(anglers), 0), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_doy BETWEEN 145 AND 152 AND fish_date_season = 2
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy, yt_per_angler DESC;
